prompt:
Here's a game idea that's unusual enough that it would feel like it was "designed by an AI," but you can still build it in Roblox.
Echo Timeline Obby
Core idea: Every time a player dies, they don't disappear. Instead, an AI-controlled "echo" of their previous run appears and repeats exactly what they did.
Gameplay
Your past selves become moving platforms.
They accidentally press buttons for you.
Some echoes open doors, while others block your path.
Later levels require working with 10-50 previous versions of yourself.
If you make a mistake, it changes the puzzle for your next attempt.
AI twist
Add an AI "Director" that watches how players perform and changes the level in real time:
If players keep failing jumps, it creates a different route.
If they're too fast, it adds harder obstacles.
It learns which paths players choose and generates new sections based on those choices.
Cool features
🌀 Infinite procedurally generated stages.
👻 Ghost replays of every attempt.
🧠 AI-generated puzzle layouts.
🏆 Daily challenge with a unique AI-created map that no one has seen before.
This kind of adaptive game would feel very different from a typical Roblox obby because the level evolves based on how people actually play.
If you'd like, I can also suggest an even more ambitious idea-something that looks like it took a team of professional developers and AI to create.
enriched: Build a dynamic 3D obby level designed as a linear progression of interconnected platforming zones where each zone features multiple branching paths and puzzle elements. The foreground includes a player path with moving platforms representing the AI-controlled "echoes" of previous runs, positioned to act as both aids and obstacles-some platforms press buttons or open doors, while others block or alter routes. The midground and background contain modular puzzle sections with doors, switches, and variable pathways that adapt spatially to player performance, allowing for alternate routes and evolving challenges. The terrain is a mix of floating platforms, narrow ledges, and vertical climbs, arranged to support up to 50 overlapping echo platforms moving in synchronized patterns. The camera faces the main path from a slight angle to showcase multiple layers of echoes and puzzle elements simultaneously. The overall layout supports procedural generation with repeated zones that can be rearranged or modified in real time, emphasizing a sense of an infinite, evolving obstacle course shaped by player interaction and AI-driven level changes.
